persona: Simulated first-time RILL user and beginner producer making an atmospheric minor-key sketch; not a human study.

findings.observation: The empty arrangement area explicitly invited double-clicking for MIDI. This opened Device library and Assign instrument created a track using Rill Lab Sine.
Pencil dragging drew named sustained notes, and drawing beyond the initial end extended the MIDI clip.
Rename project exposed an on-screen Keyboard with Clear and Apply name, allowing a unique project name with mouse input.
Duplicate was initially ambiguous as a tool versus immediate action. Tool help explained clicking clips to create independent copies; repeating then succeeded.
findings.impact: Small discoverability cost, resolved in app.

findings.observation: Dragging the audio right edge displayed End 30.000 s / Beat 57.00. After resizing both last clips the project showed 0:30.000. The MIDI miniature appeared compressed, making the precise note-timing effect unclear without opening it.
findings.impact: Exact endpoint feedback was useful; MIDI trim versus resize behavior remained uncertain.

findings.observation: The immediate playback screenshot had Pause active but no transport or meter change; a later screenshot showed 005.04.66 and active meters on both tracks and master.
findings.impact: Brief uncertainty resolved by visible playback activity; no audio was auditioned.

findings.observation: Native save dialogs were briefly late to paint, including one black frame. Subsequent screenshots showed the correct names and session folder.
findings.impact: Short wait before save/export controls were usable.

findings.observation: Save removed the unsaved marker; WAV export offered Arrangement 0:30 and effect-tail control; both WAV and MIDI showed Exported banners.
findings.impact: Requested outputs completed in the visible workflow.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: 4/5: Completed creation, note drawing, repeats, naming, save and both exports by mouse; duplicate help and endpoint interpretation added small friction.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: 4/5: Clean dark layout, clear waveforms and note previews, consistent teal controls; large unused regions felt sparse.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: 4/5: Editing and duplication responded quickly; native dialogs and first playback feedback briefly lagged, and WAV export displayed elapsed seconds.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: 2/5, higher is worse: Mostly discoverable, with uncertainty around Duplicate mode, MIDI edge resizing and initial playback feedback.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: 4/5: Instrument assignment, piano roll, audio arrangement, mixer, project save and exports covered this short sketch; advanced features were not evaluated.

outcome.status: Completed through visible UI; file contents and exact output duration pending independent verification.
outcome.composition: Four-bar A-minor/F-major/G-major/E-minor chord phrase with upper melody, repeated with supplied Circuit rhythm audio to a 30-second endpoint; final clip pair shortened.
outcome.instrument: Rill Lab Sine VST3 selected from the installed library and visible on MIDI track.
outcome.save_evidence: Unsaved marker disappeared after saving moon glass.rill.
outcome.playback_evidence: Transport and meters advanced in mixer.

limitations: Simulated beginner usability evaluation, not a human participant or benchmark.
Mouse-only interaction through the provided driver; no keyboard shortcuts or events, source inspection, app APIs, project editing, or inspection of saved composition contents.
No audio capture auditioned, so no claim about heard sound, tonal balance, clipping, or audio quality.
Laboratory virtual audio sink, software graphics, 60 ms buffering and 1024-frame requests at 48 kHz; findings do not establish physical hardware latency.
Only the installed Rill Lab Sine instrument was exercised; other plug-in editors, recording and advanced effects were not tested.
30-second endpoint and completion were observed in UI; coordinator independently verifies project, MIDI, WAV duration and PCM.
